purpose: Cricket booth package photographic background plates
commonDirection: Photorealistic 3:2 landscape; normal adult eye-level camera; open centre for composited guests; visible scenery and believable depth; architectural framing rather than repeated trees; navy, green, ivory and gold; no foreground people, logos or text.

images.prompt: Create a photorealistic premium cricket event photobooth background plate, landscape 3:2. Eye-level camera 1.5 metres high looking from entrance of a beautiful modern cricket pavilion onto an expansive green cricket oval at blue hour. Architectural dark navy pavilion uprights very near far left and far right edges, slim roof overhang at top creating natural frame within frame, warm brass detailing. Stadium lights bright far away, recognizable cricket pitch and tiny wickets in middle distance, elegant grandstands curving in distance, gentle cinematic depth. Empty clean foreground and unobstructed central 70% for later compositing photographed people from waist up; do not place objects at centre foreground. Horizon around 44% height, NOT floor-level camera. Rich forest green turf, navy evening sky, ivory highlights, gold light. Premium sports hospitality campaign photography, realistic detailed scenery, background gently soft yet recognizable. No people, no text, no logos, no cricket balls floating, no typography, no watermark.

Photorealistic landscape 3:2 cricket photobooth background plate, a distinctly different scene: elegant traditional English cricket pavilion terrace at golden hour, cream painted pavilion archways naturally framing the very outer left/right/top edges, red brick and ivory architecture, green oval and white boundary fence in middle distance, cricket scoreboard without readable writing far back at right. Eye-level 1.5m camera, horizon 43 percent height, empty centre foreground for waist-up people to be composited, wide airy field visible around them. Sunlight from side, rich emerald and ivory, restrained golden highlights, believable perspective and depth, softly distant stands, editorial sports hospitality photography. No people, no text, no logos, no floating balls, no decorative graphic borders. Keep structures and objects at edges, clean central 65 percent.

Premium photorealistic cricket photobooth background plate, landscape 3:2. View from a modern players' tunnel onto cricket ground at night. Natural frame within a frame from gently curving illuminated navy tunnel entrance along far top and outer sides, NOT tree branches. Thin warm gold architectural light strips, deep green field visible beyond, pitch and wickets far behind centre, softly blurred packed stadium stands and floodlights, very subtle celebratory golden confetti only far back in sky. Camera at normal adult chest/eye height, horizon near middle, broad unobstructed centre for later compositing waist-up guests, floor takes less than lower quarter. The field and stadium should remain expansive and visibly deep, no huge objects in middle. Crisp realistic sports photography with cinematic soft background, sophisticated navy emerald ivory gold. No people in foreground, no text, no brands, no trophies, no graphic border.

normalization: Sharp resize to 1536x1024 and WebP export. Print frames are original deterministic vector graphics rendered to transparent raster, with 1800x1200 and 1200x1800 outputs. UI and print typography are native code, not generated text.
